title: Close post-review no-op gate bypass
instructions:
Implement only Slice A from references/initiatives/post-review-worker-execution-closure.md. Use that initiative document as read-only source-of-truth for this slice. Do not start Slice B or Slice C.

Problem to fix:
- The writer no-op gate currently uses final changedFiles after verification commands run.
- A writer can therefore change nothing, have a verify command create or modify a file inside targetFiles, and be treated as non-noop.

Required behavior:
- For writer write tasks, no-op allowance must be based on pre-verification worker-produced changes, not final changedFiles after verify side effects.
- Keep final changed-file collection after verification so verification side effects remain visible to scope checks and run evidence.
- If initialChangedFiles.length === 0 and the task does not have explicit no-op allowance, evaluation.pass must be false even when HARNESS_RESULT is pass, verification passes, and final changedFiles contains a file created by verification.
- Explicit no-op allowance remains valid only when task.allowNoop === true and task.noopRationale is a non-empty string.
- Report-only behavior remains unchanged.

Implementation direction:
- In src/core/worker-result.ts, change the writer no-op allowance to use initialChangedFiles.length > 0 instead of changedFiles.length > 0. If useful for clarity, introduce a small local boolean such as workerProducedChanges.
- Do not change verify timeout behavior, setup timeout behavior, worker runtime timeout behavior, dispatch policy, CLI behavior, task templates, docs, lifecycle artifacts, merge/cleanup logic, dashboard/daemon/remote behavior, writerCap, hidden memory, or LLM semantic verification.

Required tests in tests/worker-result.test.ts:
- Add a focused regression test proving a writer task with no pre-verification changes fails even when a verify command creates a target file.
- The test should assert result.pass is false, final changedFiles includes the verify-created target file, scopeViolations are empty, and the verify command exits 0.
- Preserve existing tests proving explicit allowNoop + noopRationale can pass and report-only behavior is unchanged.

Stop conditions:
- Stop and report rework if the fix requires touching timeout code, command-runner code, worker dispatch code, policy code, CLI code, or source files outside src/core/worker-result.ts.
- Stop and report rework if the test can only pass by weakening scope checks or changing report-only semantics.

End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
expectedCommitSubject: fix: close no-op verification side-effect bypass
